WITH race_name_averages AS (
  SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS average_points
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  WHERE ds.points > 1.0
  GROUP BY r.name
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_points) AS average_points
  FROM race_name_averages
)
SELECT rna.name, rna.average_points,
       rna.average_points - oa.average_points AS difference
FROM race_name_averages AS rna
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE rna.average_points > oa.average_points
